item.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Sparks Fire and Inflicts Serious Damage at Krasnodar Refinery
item.description: The company operating the refinery said the attack took place during a maintenance stoppage that has been in place since a previous drone strike in September.

item.title: Finland Extends Russian Border Closure for Another 2 Years
item.description: The Nordic country said the widely anticipated move was necessary to “combat attempts to put pressure on Finland, strengthen border security and help Finland prepare for the most serious incidents of instrumentalized migration.”

item.title: Blackout Hits Annexed Crimea After Morning Air Raid
item.description: Local utilities providers attributed the power outage to an “accident” at energy facilities “outside” the peninsula.

item.title: Russia Lost Track of a Beloved Seal. Scientists Lost a Window Into the Wild.
item.description: A French satellite operator’s cutoff left Kroshik’s rescuers unable to track him and disrupted research on everything from Lake Baikal’s seals to Arctic sea ice.

item.title: PM Pashinyan Reaffirms Armenia’s EU Ambitions Ahead of Putin Meeting
item.description: Pashinyan also repeated plans to gradually end Armenia’s decades-long reliance on Russian border guards, who patrol its border with Turkey and Iran.

item.title: Russian TV Star With Ties to VTB Chief Backed Telegram’s Failed Crypto Venture – Report
item.description: A 2019 report by Deutsche Bank’s financial crime unit listed Nailya Asker-Zade among investors it flagged as raising concerns.

item.title: Judge Confiscates $11.8M in Property From Krasnodar First Deputy Governor
item.description: Court officials said Igor Galas acquired wealth far exceeding his declared income, registering assets under relatives’ names to conceal ownership.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine Hold First Exchange of War Dead Since Rebooted Peace Talks
item.description: Russia returned 250 bodies to Ukraine and received 22 fallen Russian soldiers in exchange, officials in Moscow said.

item.title: Deputy Commander of Russia’s Aerospace Forces Arrested in Moscow – Reports
item.description: Law enforcement sources said Colonel General Yuri Grekhov faces charges of bribery on a particularly large scale.

item.title: Trump and NATO Chief Urge Russia to Avoid Actions That Widen Ukraine War
item.description: Rutte and Trump also talked about boosting defense spending and investment in the United States and across NATO.

item.title: ‘Trapped in Grief’: Wife of Japanese Journalist Jailed by Russia Pleads for His Release
item.description: The statement from Yuki Imai’s wife marks the first time a member of his family has spoken publicly about the case.

item.title: Russian Official Warns of Ukrainian Drone Attacks on Utility Infrastructure This Winter
item.description: The comments mirrored warnings from Ukrainian leaders about the risk of winter attacks on energy infrastructure disrupting power and heating supplies.

item.title: American Billionaire Signs U.S.-Backed Share Swap Deal to Buy Lukoil Global Assets
item.description: The deal, which follows more than a year of negotiations, involves swapping Lukoil securities worth $10 billion for the company's international assets.

item.title: Z-Blogger Vladimir Romanov Resurfaces Following Rumors of Arrest
item.description: Romanov’s Telegram channel went silent last month after he published and then deleted a post that suggested a U.S.-brokered ceasefire and evacuation effort in Oleshky was unfavorable for Russia.

item.title: Putin Orders Data Center Construction Plan for Russia’s Coal Regions
item.description: The order comes as Russian officials weigh how to protect the country’s digital infrastructure from drone attacks.
